proof_body:
by
  intro R A B C X _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ f g hfg hg
  refine ⟨fun u hu => ?_, fun v hv => ?_⟩
  · ext c
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hg c
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun hu b
  · have hker : LinearMap.ker g ≤ LinearMap.ker v := by
      intro b hb
      obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := (hfg b).1 hb
      exact LinearMap.congr_fun hv a
    let e := g.quotKerEquivOfSurjective hg
    refine ⟨((LinearMap.ker g).liftQ v hker).comp e.symm.toLinearMap, ?_⟩
    ext b
    have : e.symm (g b) = (LinearMap.ker g).mkQ b := by
      apply e.injective
      simp [e]
    simp [this]
target_source: ∀ (R A B C X : Type*) [Ring R] [AddCommGroup A] [AddCommGroup B] [AddCommGroup C] [AddCommGroup X] [Module R A] [Module R B] [Module R C] [Module R X] (f : A →ₗ[R] B) (g : B →ₗ[R] C), Function.Exact f g → Function.Surjective g → (∀ u : C →ₗ[R] X, u.comp g = 0 → u = 0) ∧ ∀ v : B →ₗ[R] X, v.comp f = 0 → ∃ u : C →ₗ[R] X, u.comp g = v
